contact.basis: Original native northwest-front mainplant corner fixed before sampling; approximate historical yard/threshold datum, not certified modern terrain/shoreline.

verticalDatum: Public Terrarium composite source heights; provider-relative host visualization, not a surveyed local datum.
attribution: Mapzen terrain tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
method: Original Terrarium RGB24 bytes bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in fixed native whole historical Orlando plant/towers frame. Independent field frozen before any model geometry, without flattening or fitting.
limitations: Terrarium zoom15 output pixels may oversample much coarser native DEM.7.8125m review grid and RGB encoding are not survey accuracy.

Composite urban heights may include/interpolate structure and vegetation; exact historical yard/threshold/shoreline classification is unspecified. Compatible host field required; default coarse terrain is not automatically certified.
